apps.description:
Sayri Mobile is the Android companion and local orchestrator for Pulsar OS.

Features:
* Full Android system orchestration & dynamic application discovery
* App Functions and App Intents integration (messaging, sharing, media, alarms)
* Spatial OCR screen perception and Circle to Search gestures
* Local streaming voice dictation powered by Dicio
* Dual-device control (manage both your Android smartphone and your Linux PC)
* Seamless zero-configuration network pairing with PIN verification
* Markdown rendering, clipboard copy, and voice responses
apps.name: Sayri Mobile
apps.summary: The AI Operating System Copilot on Android, synchronized with Pulsar OS
